title: TCG:Omens and Legacies
summary: Omens and Legacies is the third and final regular card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. This set saw the introduction of new Blood Spiral heroes and the new "Forceful" special power. It also delved into the backstories of established Seekers, featuring cards of younger versions of characters such as The Professor and Zhalia Moon. The set was planned to be followed by Labyrinth of Doom, but Upper Deck filed for bankruptcy before the next set of cards could be released.

full_text:
Omens and Legacies is the third and final regular card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. This set saw the introduction of new Blood Spiral heroes and the new "Forceful" special power. It also delved into the backstories of established Seekers, featuring cards of younger versions of characters such as The Professor and Zhalia Moon. The set was planned to be followed by Labyrinth of Doom, but Upper Deck filed for bankruptcy before the next set of cards could be released.

{{Infobox TCG
| image  = File:Omens and Legacies boosters.png
| set    = Omens and Legacies
| date   = October 09, 2009
| id     = OAL
| count  = 100
| pre by = [[TCG:Legendary Saga|Legendary Saga]]
| fol by = [[TCG:Labyrinth of Doom|Labyrinth of Doom]] (cancelled)
}}
'''Omens and Legacies''' is the third and final regular card set of the [[Huntik Trading Card Game]]. This set saw the introduction of new [[Blood Spiral]] heroes and the new "Forceful" special power. It also delved into the backstories of established Seekers, featuring cards of younger versions of characters such as [[Simon Judeau|The Professor]] and [[Zhalia Moon]]. The set was planned to be followed by [[Labyrinth of Doom]], but [[Upper Deck]] filed for bankruptcy before the next set of cards could be released.
